_comment: The ledges pack's tile kind as a pack concept (content sets GEN-5): it presents its own terrain entry (structure layer), declares the maze base it falls back to with no art (TILE-1's chain: marker, since the cell stays floor), and names its shape recipe in this pack's art layer.
